pages.text: These are $(item)Armor sets$() worn by the $(thing)Guardians of light$() in $(lissa)Birth by Sleep$(). The armor once protected its wearer from the $(lissa)darkness$() surrounding the lanes between, now it protects you in combat. If you own an entire set, you can craft them together, to obtain it's corresponding $(item)Pauldron$(), which you can place into the $(l:kingdomkeys:learning_the_menu/item_tab)Pauldron Slot$(), to then summon your Armor with $(thing)[$(k:key.kingdomkeys.summonarmor)]$().

These armor sets can be crafted in the style of $(#cc7a22)Terra$(), $(#335cc1)Aqua$(), $(#80d11d)Ventus$(), $(#b6b6c9)Eraqus$(), $(#5d5d5d)Xehanort$() and $(#1a1827)Ventus' Nightmare form$(). Get in a Smithing Table and combine some netherite armor and an upgrade template with an $(#cc7a22)orange$(), $(#335cc1)blue$(), $(#80d11d)lime green$(), $(#b6b6c9)white$() or $(#5d5d5d)gray$() and $(#1a1827)black$() dye.$(p)Additionally a Pauldron can be enchanted by holding it and holding down RMB, while wearing a set of armor with the desired enchantments. $(thing)Attention$(): The currently worn armor will be disentchanted in the process!

In a $(thing)Smithing Table$(), combine a piece of $(item)netherite armor$(), an $(item)upgrade template$() and a $(#cc7a22)orange$() dye to get each piece of the $(thing)Terra$() set. With all 4 pieces you can craft this pauldron.

In a $(thing)Smithing Table$(), combine a piece of $(item)netherite armor$(), an $(item)upgrade template$() and a $(#335cc1)blue$() dye to get each piece of the $(thing)Aqua$() set. With all 4 pieces you can craft this pauldron.

In a $(thing)Smithing Table$(), combine a piece of $(item)netherite armor$(), an $(item)upgrade template$() and a $(#80d11d)lime green$() dye to get each piece of the $(thing)Ventus$() set. With all 4 pieces you can craft this pauldron.

In a $(thing)Smithing Table$(), combine a piece of $(item)netherite armor$(), an $(item)upgrade template$() and a $(#b6b6c9)white$() dye to get each piece of the $(thing)Eraqus$() set. With all 4 pieces you can craft this pauldron.

In a $(thing)Smithing Table$(), combine a piece of $(item)netherite armor$(), an $(item)upgrade template$() and a $(#5d5d5d)gray$() dye to get each piece of the $(thing)Xehanort$() set. With all 4 pieces you can craft this pauldron.

In a $(thing)Smithing Table$(), combine a piece of $(item)netherite armor$(), an $(item)upgrade template$() and a $(#1a1827)black$() dye to get each piece of the $(thing)Ventus' Nightmare$() set. With all 4 pieces you can craft this pauldron.
